<thought>To find a retrosynthetic template for a Diels‑Alder reaction, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a C=C double bond (the dienophile) and form a new C‑C single bond (the cycloaddition). This should retrieve a suitable Diels‑Alder template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C=C"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
